messages:
marta: Hey team, Acme wants a 2-week POC to validate invoice extraction + contextual Q&A. They asked about sandbox data access, redaction, and pass/fail criteria. Quick sync?
samir: +1. Need to confirm what sample data they can share and whether we can use a sanitized S3 bucket or need VPC peering.
eileen: For timelines: week 0 setup, week 1 evals and prompt tuning, week 2 final run + handoff. Is that what Acme expects?
alex-acme: correct on timeline. We can provide ~500 sample invoices, but must be fully redacted for PII per our security policy. Also need pricing estimate for Dedicated pool during the POC.
marta: Ok. Pricing: suggest estimate for a small Dedicated slot (4-GPU equivalent) for 2 weeks + data transfer. I'll send an initial ballpark after samir confirms expected token volumes.
samir: On data access options: 1) sanitized S3 with presigned URLs 2) temporary S3 role (recommended) 3) VPC peering (if they want private deployment). For POC speed, presigned URLs are simplest.
zoe-security: We need to approve the redaction approach. If they only remove PII fields (name, SSN, email) that's OK. But we must ensure no free-text PII remains. We'll need a short questionnaire answered: who will do redaction, retention window, KMS usage.
alex-acme: we can run redaction. Prefer to share already-redacted files. We can also provide a small unredacted subset in a secure file share if needed for debugging.
eileen: Great. Success criteria proposal: (1) >= 92% invoice field extraction F1 on provided eval set, (2) mean latency < 600ms for 512-token prompts on Dedicated, (3) end-to-end QA accuracy >= 88% on contextual questions, (4) no PII leaks in 100 random synthetic probes.
marta: Nice. Add acceptance: runbook for graceful fallback to hosted model if Dedicated capacity throttles.
samir: Operational checklist for sandbox: - Create s3://acme-poc-redacted/ with perms to upload - Share presigned PUT URLs for up to 500 objects - Provide a manifest.csv with object path and expected labels - Provide ground-truth JSON for evals
samir: Example presign CLI we can provide:

```
aws s3 presign s3://acme-poc-redacted/invoices/2026-01-01-001.json --expires-in 86400
```

marta: We'll also require a short mapping doc for label schema (field names, types).
zoe-security: For compliance, please confirm: retention = 30 days (default), objects encrypted with SSE-KMS, and logs forwarded to Acme's SIEM via CloudWatch. If any of these cannot be met, flag now.
alex-acme: retention 30 days is fine. We can encrypt with KMS. Logs forwarding might need a connector — would that be on our side or Redwood's?
eileen: We can push logs to a customer-owned CloudWatch or Splunk endpoint over a secure pipeline; ops team to confirm.
ops-bot: deploy: created sandbox infra ticket INF-9123; owner @samir; ETA 48h for presign URL pipeline.
samir: Blockers: security questionnaire outstanding (they asked about SOC2 and data residency). Zoe can we get the short answers? Also need clarification if Acme requires EU data region.
zoe-security: SOC2: Redwood is SOC2 Type II in our enterprise pack (attach cert). Data residency: Hosted defaults to us-east-1, Dedicated/private can be in eu-west-1 — need to know customer preference.
marta: Action items: - Alex: upload redacted sample + manifest by Tue EOD (ASAP) - Samir: spin presign pipeline + infra ticket (48h) - Zoe: send SOC2 cert + complete short answers (today) - Eileen: prepare eval harness + prompts (tomorrow)
alex-acme: will upload by Tue EOD. One question: can we run privacy probes automatically (like regex/PII checks) during ingest? That would speed sign-off.
samir: Yes, we can run an automated PII probe during ingest and return a preflight report. We'll include a sample regex set and false-positive tuning knob.
eileen: For prompts/evals, please include edge-case invoices (handwritten totals, multiple currencies). We'll create a small prompt set and evaluation script. Example eval command we'll run:

```
python eval_invoices.py --manifest manifest.csv --predictions predictions/ --metrics output.json
```

marta: Pricing note: If they want Dedicated for just 2 weeks, we can offer a short-term promo rate for pilot. I'll follow up offline with exact numbers.
zoe-security: Final security ask: who on Acme signs the DPA? We need a legal contact.
alex-acme: legal contact is tara@acme.com. I'll loop her in once we have the manifest.
marta: Perfect. I'll draft an email template to tara with DPA + SOC2 attach and cc the team. Anything else?
alex-acme: please include the KMS key alias and instructions for a temp IAM role if we end up going that route.
eileen: I'll prepare the eval harness repo and a quick how-to doc for running the POC locally.
samir: OK, I'll update INF-9123 with infra steps and timelines. ping me if anything blocks.
marta: Thanks all :rocket: we'll reconvene Thurs AM for a quick sync after uploads.
